aggregate.algorithm: sha256 over UTF-8 of json.dumps([{path,bytes,lf,sha256} for index.html,styles.css,app.js in fixed order], sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')); object keys sorted, no spaces, no trailing newline; per-file sha256 is over raw bytes; bytes and sha256 are aggregate inputs, so CRLF/CR bytes are part of the aggregate; the CR count field is informational only and no line-ending normalization is applied.
aggregate.crlf_note: index.html raw bytes are CRLF (cr=34); raw-byte sha256 and bytes include the CR bytes; aggregate is byte-sensitive and does not normalize line endings.
aggregate.path_portability: aggregate includes _A/... local store paths; not portable if the store is moved/renamed; the app bytes may be identical while the aggregate changes. This is a disclosed portability limitation/backlog, not a claim of a portable product identity.
